name: Cancer
shortDescription: RoMIUS Urology provides comprehensive, state-of-the-art care for the full spectrum of urologic cancers. Our team combines advanced diagnostics, robotic and minimally invasive surgery, multidisciplinary collaboration, and personalized treatment planning to deliver exceptional outcomes for patients across Northwest and West Central Ohio.
body:
Prostate Cancer

RoMIUS Urology offers complete, coordinated care for men with prostate cancer—from early detection to advanced treatment pathways. We are the regional leaders in robotic prostatectomy, having performed the highest volume of minimally invasive prostate cancer surgery in the Northwest and West Central Ohio region with exceptional outcomes.

As part of our advanced prostate cancer program, we have integrated URO Pharmacy, a specialty pharmacy with a dedicated urology-specific pharmacist and pharmacy technician. This team works directly with our providers to optimize systemic therapy selections, streamline access to medications, and support patients throughout their treatment journey.

We collaborate closely with radiation oncology and medical oncology partners across the region to ensure each patient receives a fully coordinated, multidisciplinary plan—whether that includes active surveillance, radiation therapy, hormonal therapy, systemic treatments, or surgery.

Kidney Cancer

Our surgeons are leaders in robotic and minimally invasive kidney surgery, specializing in partial (nephron-sparing) nephrectomy, complex tumor removal, and techniques designed to preserve kidney function whenever possible. We offer comprehensive evaluation for kidney masses, including advanced imaging, biopsy when appropriate, and personalized surveillance protocols for small renal lesions.

For patients with advanced or metastatic renal cell carcinoma, we collaborate closely with medical oncology to coordinate systemic therapies such as immunotherapy and targeted agents. This multidisciplinary partnership ensures each patient receives the most modern, effective, and individualized treatment plan across all stages of kidney cancer.

Bladder Cancer

RoMIUS Urology provides expert care across the full spectrum of bladder cancer, with a focus on early detection, in-office cystoscopy, and the most cutting-edge intravesical treatments—including advanced immunotherapy and chemotherapy instillation protocols tailored to tumor grade, stage, and recurrence risk.

For patients with more advanced disease, our team performs robotic radical cystectomy and complex urinary reconstruction with precision and a focus on functional outcomes. We work closely with oncology colleagues to deliver coordinated, stage-appropriate treatment from diagnosis through long-term surveillance and survivorship.

Testicular Cancer

We emphasize rapid evaluation and early diagnosis for testicular cancer, with attention to fertility preservation and minimally invasive treatment. Our surgeons emphasize prompt evaluation with subsequent radical orchiectomy and coordinate chemotherapy, surveillance, and long-term follow-up planning with regional oncology teams. This collaborative, streamlined approach helps achieve high cure rates and individualized care for every patient.
